mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT dsp.* FROM dsp_slot_info AS dsp INNER JOIN dsp_launch AS launch ON launch.dsp_slot_id = dsp.id WHERE launch.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND launch.deleted = 0 AND dsp.deleted = 0 ORDER BY dsp.id DESC
SELECT launch.* FROM dsp_launch AS launch WHERE launch.ssp_slot_id = #{sspSlotId} AND launch.deleted = 0 ORDER BY launch.id DESC
SELECT launch.* FROM dsp_launch AS launch WHERE launch.dsp_slot_id = #{dspSlotId} AND launch.deleted = 0 ORDER BY launch.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ssp.*,app.os_type as osType FROM ssp_slot_info AS ssp INNER JOIN dsp_launch AS launch ON launch.ssp_slot_id = ssp.id LEFT JOIN ssp_app AS app ON ssp.app_id = app.id WHERE launch.dsp_slot_id = #{dspSlotId} AND launch.deleted = 0 AND ssp.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ssp.id DESC
SELECT launch.* FROM dsp_launch AS launch WHERE launch.ssp_slot_id = #{id} AND launch.deleted = 0 ORDER BY launch.id DESC
